risk_note: RV2 orders / settlement / union / growth (B1-08zi; FU-REFUNDED-QUANTITY-WRITER, gap 17; D10-811 ① / D10-814 / D10-854 / D10-864; BR-FUND-03, BR-FUND-07, BR-CALC-15, BR-FUND-01, BR-FUND-05). JD skuReturnNum / skuNum are written to orders.refunded_quantity / quantity on first insert and on sync in the same transaction (Taobao / PDD stay null, never inferred); a missing value keeps the stored one and the quantity never decreases (a lower value is not written and raises an alert); a quantity-only change does not move commission_version. refunded_quantity_at_credit is frozen once in the credit CAS (casCreditOrder). Every money effect driven by the JD refunded quantity sits behind orders.jd.refunded_quantity_r9_enabled (seed 0006, default off): off → no R9 clawback and no invite-reward void, only an alert. Known gaps followed up: FU-JD-REMAINING-ZERO-VOID (pre-credit remaining 0 → R6 VOID when the switch is on; money r1 S1, D10-864) and FU-INVITE-REWARD-ORDER-PLATFORM (invite-reward order facts lack platform, D10-854 ②); neither has a production effect while the switch is off.
